cross_validation: leave one complete strip_id out; all five lights removed
primary_comparison: phone_spline minus spline_additive; negative error differences favor phone-specific smooth pH trajectories
important_scope: This tests interpolation of an unobserved phone x pH cell from neighboring pH levels. It does not test a second independent physical strip at the same phone x pH.
limitations: Only one physical strip exists per phone x pH cell.
Spline smoothness is a modeling assumption and is examined with basis-count sensitivity analysis.
Boundary pH values are harder because one-sided interpolation is required.
